title: Learn To Think In English | Speak Clearly & Naturally
speaker: mmmEnglish
zh: 【mmmEnglish】學會用英語思考|說話清晰自然（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Learning to think in English will make you more confident speaking English
cues.en: Learning to think in English will make you more confident speaking English
cues.zh: 學習以英文思考會讓你講英語更有自信

cues.text: because you'll speak more naturally and fluently with less hesitation.
cues.en: because you'll speak more naturally and fluently with less hesitation.
cues.zh: 因為這樣你會講得更自然流利不猶豫

cues.text: I can already hear you saying "But Emma, I need to think in my native language to
cues.en: I can already hear you saying "But Emma, I need to think in my native language to
cues.zh: 我知道你一定會說， 但是Emma，我需要以母語思考然後翻譯成英語

cues.text: translate! It's too hard, I don't know enough vocabulary to do it!"
cues.en: translate! It's too hard, I don't know enough vocabulary to do it!"
cues.zh: 但是Emma，我需要以母語思考然後翻譯成英語 這太難了！我的字彙量不足以這麼做

cues.text: But listen, that is the long, slow and painful road to English fluency. When you do this, your
cues.en: But listen, that is the long, slow and painful road to English fluency. When you do this, your
cues.zh: 聽好了，試圖以那樣的方式達到英語流利， 是條既漫長又痛苦的的路 當你那麼做，你的英語聽起來就不自然

cues.text: English sounds unnatural because the sentence structure is different in your
cues.en: English sounds unnatural because the sentence structure is different in your
cues.zh: 當你那麼做，你的英語聽起來就不自然 因為你母語的文句結構不同

cues.text: language and it probably takes you a long time to say what you need to say
cues.en: language and it probably takes you a long time to say what you need to say
cues.zh: 因為你母語的文句結構不同 而且你大概會花滿多時間來說出你想表達的

cues.text: because you're translating in your head as you speak. We're going to learn a few
cues.en: because you're translating in your head as you speak. We're going to learn a few
cues.zh: 因為你一邊講話一邊在腦中翻譯 我們將學習幾個訓練大腦以英語思考的方法

cues.text: strategies to help train your brain to think in English.
cues.en: strategies to help train your brain to think in English.
cues.zh: 我們將學習幾個訓練大腦以英語思考的方法

cues.text: So start with very simple vocabulary. When you're at home, think about the English word for things
cues.en: So start with very simple vocabulary. When you're at home, think about the English word for things
cues.zh: 首先從簡單的字彙開始 你在家時，想想你身旁那些東西的英文單字：

cues.text: that you see around you. Shoes, flowers, desk, door.
cues.en: that you see around you. Shoes, flowers, desk, door.
cues.zh: 你在家時，想想你身旁那些東西的英文單字： shoes（鞋）, flowers（花）, desk（書桌）, door（門）

cues.text: When you're on the train or you're driving to work, look out the window and think of the English word for
cues.en: When you're on the train or you're driving to work, look out the window and think of the English word for
cues.zh: 你搭車或開車上班途中，從車窗往外看， 想想你看到的東西的英文單字：

cues.text: the things that you see. Dog, factory, busy, windy, people.
cues.en: the things that you see. Dog, factory, busy, windy, people.
cues.zh: 想想你看到的東西的英文單字： dog（狗）, factory（工廠）, busy（忙碌的）, windy（颳風的）, people（人們）

cues.text: In fact, we're going to try it right now!
cues.en: In fact, we're going to try it right now!
cues.zh: 我們現在立刻就來練習一下

cues.text: So, I want you to close your eyes, take a deep breath. Because when you
cues.en: So, I want you to close your eyes, take a deep breath. Because when you
cues.zh: 我要你閉上眼睛，深呼吸 當你睜開眼睛時你將看看身處的房間四周

cues.text: open your eyes you're going to look around the room in front of you
cues.en: open your eyes you're going to look around the room in front of you
cues.zh: 當你睜開眼睛時你將看看身處的房間四周

cues.text: and think in English - only in English - not in your native language. You're going to
cues.en: and think in English - only in English - not in your native language. You're going to
cues.zh: 並以英語思考，只用英語，而非你的母語 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？

cues.text: think in English of the words for everything that you see around you.
cues.en: think in English of the words for everything that you see around you.
cues.zh: 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？

cues.text: Okay, so take that deep breath again. And open your eyes and look around you.
cues.en: Okay, so take that deep breath again. And open your eyes and look around you.
cues.zh: 就用英語去想你在周遭看到的一切事物的英文，好嗎？ 現在再次深呼吸，睜開眼睛，看看四周

cues.text: Thinking of the English words only.
cues.en: Thinking of the English words only.
cues.zh: 心中只用英語單字去想

cues.text: Great! Now, if that was easy, we can move on to the next level. If it was hard
cues.en: Great! Now, if that was easy, we can move on to the next level. If it was hard
cues.zh: 好極了！若你覺得容易，那我們可進入下個階段 若你覺得困難，那也沒關係

cues.text: that's okay too! But you'll need to practise every day
cues.en: that's okay too! But you'll need to practise every day
cues.zh: 若你覺得困難，那也沒關係 不過你便需要每天在不同地方重複這個練習

cues.text: doing the same thing in different places - it will become easier. You're training
cues.en: doing the same thing in different places - it will become easier. You're training
cues.zh: 不過你便需要每天在不同地方重複這個練習 你就會覺得越來越容易了 你在訓練自己用英語去想

cues.text: yourself to think in English. So you can do it at home or at work, on the train or
cues.en: yourself to think in English. So you can do it at home or at work, on the train or
cues.zh: 你在訓練自己用英語去想 不論是在家、辦公室、通勤時 還是在咖啡聽等朋友時，都可進行練習

cues.text: when you're at the cafe waiting for a friend.
cues.en: when you're at the cafe waiting for a friend.
cues.zh: 還是在咖啡聽等朋友時，都可進行練習

cues.text: Then you can move on to simple sentences. For example, your hair's really long or what's he eating for lunch?
cues.en: Then you can move on to simple sentences. For example, your hair's really long or what's he eating for lunch?
cues.zh: 之後你便可以推進到簡單的句子 例如：（你的頭髮好長）或（他午餐在吃什麼？）

cues.text: Or that chair looks really uncomfortable.
cues.en: Or that chair looks really uncomfortable.
cues.zh: （那張椅子看起來真不舒服）

cues.text: So do the same thing now. I want you to look around the room and make three
cues.en: So do the same thing now. I want you to look around the room and make three
cues.zh: 現在進行剛才的練習，我要你望向房間四周 並就你所見造三個簡單的句子

cues.text: simple sentences about what you see. Remember, no translating! You're not
cues.en: simple sentences about what you see. Remember, no translating! You're not
cues.zh: 並就你所見造三個簡單的句子 注意！不許翻譯 不許用母語去想任何東西

cues.text: allowed to think in your native language at all. And if this is too difficult, go
cues.en: allowed to think in your native language at all. And if this is too difficult, go
cues.zh: 不許用母語去想任何東西 若覺得這樣太困難，就回復到字彙練習

cues.text: back to thinking of simple vocabulary words. Okay, so close your eyes,
cues.en: back to thinking of simple vocabulary words. Okay, so close your eyes,
cues.zh: 若覺得這樣太困難，就回復到字彙練習 好，眼睛閉上，深呼吸，開始

cues.text: take a deep breath, go.
cues.en: take a deep breath, go.
cues.zh: 好，眼睛閉上，深呼吸，開始

cues.text: Okay, if that was easy, you can move to the next level which is to plan your day
cues.en: Okay, if that was easy, you can move to the next level which is to plan your day
cues.zh: 若你覺得很容易，那你便可進入下個階段 用英語去想，用英語計劃你的一天

cues.text: in English - thinking in English. So when you wake up in the morning and you're
cues.en: in English - thinking in English. So when you wake up in the morning and you're
cues.zh: 用英語去想，用英語計劃你的一天 當你在早晨醒來還躺在床上時

cues.text: still lying in bed, think about everything that you need to
cues.en: still lying in bed, think about everything that you need to
cues.zh: 當你在早晨醒來還躺在床上時 用英語去想你當天要做的每一件事

cues.text: do that day - in English.
cues.en: do that day - in English.
cues.zh: 用英語去想你當天要做的每一件事

cues.text: After I eat breakfast I'll walk to the bus stop
cues.en: After I eat breakfast I'll walk to the bus stop
cues.zh: （吃完早餐後，我將走到公車站牌）

cues.text: and I'll catch the bus to work. On the bus, I'm going to read my book.
cues.en: and I'll catch the bus to work. On the bus, I'm going to read my book.
cues.zh: （並搭乘公車去工作） （在公車上我將讀我的書）

cues.text: I'm meeting Matilda for lunch today and I think we're going to get takeaway and eat it
cues.en: I'm meeting Matilda for lunch today and I think we're going to get takeaway and eat it
cues.zh: （今天我會與Matilda一起午餐） （我想我們會買外帶到公園用餐）

cues.text: in the park. It's going to be such a nice day.
cues.en: in the park. It's going to be such a nice day.
cues.zh: （今天我會與Matilda一起午餐） （我想我們會買外帶到公園用餐）

cues.text: So when thinking in English sentences and planning your day with simple sentences becomes easy, move on to
cues.en: So when thinking in English sentences and planning your day with simple sentences becomes easy, move on to
cues.zh: 當你覺得，用英語去想， 並用簡單語句計劃你的一天變容易了 就進到假想會話

cues.text: thinking in conversation. Now, this is great when you're sunbaking on the beach
cues.en: thinking in conversation. Now, this is great when you're sunbaking on the beach
cues.zh: 就進到假想會話 這麼做會很棒。當你在海灘做日光浴，

cues.text: or hiking up a mountain or you're in the shower getting ready for your day
cues.en: or hiking up a mountain or you're in the shower getting ready for your day
cues.zh: 或在登山健行，或在淋浴，為一天做準備 腦中有自己獨處的時間，沒有其他東西使你分心

cues.text: and you have some time alone in your head. So there's nothing to distract you!
cues.en: and you have some time alone in your head. So there's nothing to distract you!
cues.zh: 腦中有自己獨處的時間，沒有其他東西使你分心

cues.text: Now thinking in conversation is really great because you're asking the questions then
cues.en: Now thinking in conversation is really great because you're asking the questions then
cues.zh: 練習假想會話很棒，因為你不僅發問 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去

cues.text: thinking of answers to those same questions and also ways to keep the
cues.en: thinking of answers to those same questions and also ways to keep the
cues.zh: 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去

cues.text: conversation going, so it's really great conversation practice.
cues.en: conversation going, so it's really great conversation practice.
cues.zh: 也思考著問題的答案，還想著如何讓對話進行下去 所以是很好的對話練習 如果在腦中與自己講話聽起來怪怪的或很蠢......

cues.text: Now, if talking to yourself in your head sounds strange or silly...
cues.en: Now, if talking to yourself in your head sounds strange or silly...
cues.zh: 如果在腦中與自己講話聽起來怪怪的或很蠢......

cues.text: well I guess it probably is! Get one of your friends to help. And no, I don't mean
cues.en: well I guess it probably is! Get one of your friends to help. And no, I don't mean
cues.zh: 我想確實是有一點 那就叫你的朋友幫忙！ ㄟ不是，我不是指叫你朋友跟你一起淋浴

cues.text: ask one of your friends to have a shower with you, that would get maybe a little
cues.en: ask one of your friends to have a shower with you, that would get maybe a little
cues.zh: ㄟ不是，我不是指叫你朋友跟你一起淋浴 那樣可能會有點莫名其妙且尷尬

cues.text: bit weird and awkward. You might not have the same relationship again after that.
cues.en: bit weird and awkward. You might not have the same relationship again after that.
cues.zh: 那樣可能會有點莫名其妙且尷尬 之後你們的關係可能就回不去了

cues.text: I just mean, imagine that they are part of the conversation in your head,
cues.en: I just mean, imagine that they are part of the conversation in your head,
cues.zh: 我指的是，想像他們是你假想會話的物件 當你問問題時，他們會怎麼回答？

cues.text: so when you're asking the questions, how would they answer?
cues.en: so when you're asking the questions, how would they answer?
cues.zh: 當你問問題時，他們會怎麼回答？

cues.text: What would they think about the things you're saying?
cues.en: What would they think about the things you're saying?
cues.zh: 他們對你說的話會有什麼想法？

cues.text: As you're walking down the street, in your head you could be saying "It's so hot today, isn't it?"
cues.en: As you're walking down the street, in your head you could be saying "It's so hot today, isn't it?"
cues.zh: 走在街上時，你在心裡可能會說：今天有夠熱對不對？

cues.text: "Yeah it is! I wish I brought my hat, that sun is scorching! It reminds me of a week that I
cues.en: "Yeah it is! I wish I brought my hat, that sun is scorching! It reminds me of a week that I
cues.zh: 對啊，要是我有帶帽子來就好了，這太陽想燒死人 讓我不禁想起在杜拜的某一週，氣溫超過攝氏40度

cues.text: spent in Dubai actually. It was over 40 degrees Celsius!"
cues.en: spent in Dubai actually. It was over 40 degrees Celsius!"
cues.zh: 讓我不禁想起在杜拜的某一週，氣溫超過攝氏40度

cues.text: "Hey are you sure that Sally's meeting us here? We've been waiting for so long now!"
cues.en: "Hey are you sure that Sally's meeting us here? We've been waiting for so long now!"
cues.zh: ㄟ，你確定Sally是要在這跟我們碰面？ 我們已經等很久了

cues.text: Practising this skill and doing it regularly will help train your brain to think in English.
cues.en: Practising this skill and doing it regularly will help train your brain to think in English.
cues.zh: 經常練習這項技能 有助於訓練你的腦袋瓜用英語思考

cues.text: I recommend that you find a time in your day where you always do this every day.
cues.en: I recommend that you find a time in your day where you always do this every day.
cues.zh: 我建議你在一天中找個時段來經常練習

cues.text: So for example, every morning after you brush your teeth, spend five minutes
cues.en: So for example, every morning after you brush your teeth, spend five minutes
cues.zh: 舉例，每天早晨刷完牙後 花五分鐘用英文進行假想會話

cues.text: thinking in conversation or planning your day. Or it could be on your lunch
cues.en: thinking in conversation or planning your day. Or it could be on your lunch
cues.zh: 花五分鐘用英文進行假想會話 或計劃你的一天 或是在你午休時

cues.text: break. Work on it every day and you will make it happen! You will train your brain
cues.en: break. Work on it every day and you will make it happen! You will train your brain
cues.zh: 或是在你午休時 每天都下工夫，就能實現目標 你將訓練大腦用英語思考

cues.text: to think in English so that when it comes to speaking in English, it flows
cues.en: to think in English so that when it comes to speaking in English, it flows
cues.zh: 你將訓練大腦用英語思考 如此一來，在英語口說方面 語句就會從腦中自然湧流出來

cues.text: naturally. Your words flow naturally because you're not translating in your
cues.en: naturally. Your words flow naturally because you're not translating in your
cues.zh: 語句就會從腦中自然湧流出來 你所說的字句自然流暢，因為你並不在腦中翻譯

cues.text: head. You're thinking in English.
cues.en: head. You're thinking in English.
cues.zh: 你所說的字句自然流暢，因為你並不在腦中翻譯 你直接用英語思考

cues.text: Now, there's heaps more videos to watch on my YouTube channel and if you sign up for my emails on my website, you'll get five
cues.en: Now, there's heaps more videos to watch on my YouTube channel and if you sign up for my emails on my website, you'll get five
cues.zh: 在我的YouTube頻道有更多影片 若你在我的網站訂閱我的電郵釋出 你就會收到五堂免費的發音課程

cues.text: free pronunciation lessons so visit www.mmmenglish.com/signup
cues.en: free pronunciation lessons so visit www.mmmenglish.com/signup
cues.zh: 你就會收到五堂免費的發音課程 請造訪：www.mmmenglish.com/signup

cues.text: See you soon!
cues.en: See you soon!
cues.zh: 我們很快再會！
